title: US Plug-in (Balcony) Solar Laws by State
subtitle: Plug-in solar law status, bill and start date for each US state and territory
description:
{{description}}

A copy of the table at https://sunderstand.com/plug-in-solar/legislation?utm_source=kaggle, which has each state's full rules and is the place to read and cite it.

**Informational, not legal advice; verify with the source link.**

There is no size-limit column. Not every row has a bill, source link or date ("No law found" and "Not yet researched" rows have no source link).

fields.name: state
fields.description: State, District of Columbia or territory name.

fields.name: bill
fields.description: The bill or act number; blank where no bill exists or while the number is being confirmed.

fields.name: takes_effect
fields.description: The date a signed law takes effect; blank if none.

fields.name: source_link
fields.description: The government page that was read (statute, bill, legislature record or governor's announcement); blank where there is none.

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: Sunderstand's page for that state; blank for the territories.

fields.name: checked_on
fields.description: The date the row was last checked; blank for the territories (not yet researched).
